title: filago carpetana subsp. maroccana
intro: Filago carpetana subsp. maroccana, commonly known as North African cress or Maroccan fleabane, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Filago carpetana subsp. maroccana are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
